answer: Throttle rewards by earned tenure: each key accrues one 'ember' per epoch only when a jury passes its answer, and its reward cap is 10% of a full share until it holds 30 embers. A farm of 50 fresh keys thus earns 50 x 0.1 = 5 shares, not 50, so splitting yields 10x less per key than it appears. A 'signal' check by 3 random graders flags near-duplicate answers across keys. Weakness: patient attackers age keys through a quiet 'tundra' stretch. Fix: embers come only from passed juries, never from idle time, so aging costs 30 real passing answers per key.
